publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Guilherme Sabino

record.title: A finite stream of real accelerometer samples
record.method: Raw MPU6050 reads after live mapping admission; UART/counter analysis
record.observation: One finite trial records 100 consecutive MPU6050 samples over 14.562433 seconds, at 6.7983 observed callbacks/s, with monotonic timestamps and finite MPU/TWI restoration.
record.limits: This rate is not hardware output data rate. No orientation calibration, stock HID motion publication or app rotation is accepted. There is no owner hand test.
